import pandas as pd

# Feature engineering for f_27 string column
def extract_string_features(df, col="f_27"):
    df = df.copy()
    # Length of string
    df[col + "_len"] = df[col].str.len()
    # Count of unique characters
    df[col + "_unique"] = df[col].apply(lambda x: len(set(x)))

    # Entropy calculation
    def entropy(s):
        if len(s) == 0:
            return 0
        freq = {}
        for c in s:
            freq[c] = freq.get(c, 0) + 1
        prob = [v / len(s) for v in freq.values()]
        return -sum(p * np.log2(p + 1e-10) for p in prob)

    df[col + "_entropy"] = df[col].apply(entropy)
    # Count specific letters
    for letter in "ABCDEFGHIJ":
        df[col + "_" + letter + "_count"] = df[col].str.count(letter)
    return df
